notes:
Composed of ⟦{美|び}→美：28891_bi⟧ (beauty) + {顔|がん} (face). Commonly used as a prefix in beauty product and skincare vocabulary. The word emphasizes both the state of having a beautiful face and the practice of facial care.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美顔|びがん}{器|き}: facial beauty device
- {美顔|びがん}ローラー: facial roller
- {美顔|びがん}エステ: facial esthetic treatment
- {美顔|びがん}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: facial beauty effect
- {美顔|びがん}⟦マッサージ→マッサージ：00272_massaaji⟧: facial beauty massage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美肌|びはだ}→美肌：14204_bihada⟧: beautiful skin — focuses on skin quality rather than the face overall
- ⟦{美容|びよう}→美容：00014_biyou⟧: beauty, cosmetics — broader term covering all aspects of personal beauty care
- フェイシャル: facial (treatment) — loanword used specifically for professional treatments
